sandeep_runtime: FYI I'm seeing a recurring TTFT spike on route /gen/chat when micro-slices overlap with a KV eviction. Not identical to earlier prefetch noise — this looks like kernel swap jitter + a short path where we choose a different microkernel. Flame snippet below. Anyone seen this pattern?

sandeep_runtime: flame: kernel_time dominates then ~120ms wait, then decode kernel runs; KV hit rate drops briefly. Repro on canary with small payloads (len 60) and aggressive softbatching.

anna_ml: :eyes: can you paste the flame or a trace id? sounds like the kernel selector might be flipping because sequence length changes after prefetch?

sandeep_runtime: trace id rt-20260318-29, flame pasted: 
```
kernel_selector.cpp:choose() +12ms
kernel_runner.cu:invoke() +30ms
kv_cache.cpp:evict_if_needed() +8ms
microbatch_scheduler:handoff_wait +120ms
kernel_runner.cu:invoke() +15ms
```

mike_sre: is this visible in the token-level breakdown dashboards? p95 TTFT for that route?

sandeep_runtime: p50 ~ 45ms, p95 jumps to 230ms during incident windows. Token breakdown shows kernel_time + handshake wait increase. I suspect we are falling back to a different kernel variant while eviction is finishing and then reselecting back causing two short kernels back-to-back.

lee_infra: could be the kernel warmup amortization path — we saw similar when a worker swapped tensor cores and the selector retried on different algos. Is there a corresponding spike in "kernel_switch_count" in logs?

sandeep_runtime: kernel_switch_count increases by ~1-2 per request in repro, yes. Also KV miss spike ~+3% for a sec.

anna_ml: proposal: add a transient tag when selector decision changes within the same token stream and expose it as a per-route KPI. then we can chart correlation between selector flips and TTFT spikes. Minimal change: add metric selector_transition{route,from,to} with a counter.

mike_sre: +1. Also we should instrument micro-slice boundaries in the token-breakdown dashboard (new panel: "slice boundary waits") to see if handoff_wait aligns with slice edges. For alerts, set alert if selector_transition rate > 0.1% and p95 TTFT increases > 50ms over baseline.

lee_infra: I'll add a probe to the runtime that emits a trace event on kernel_select + kernel_start + kernel_end with slice_id. We can roll out to canary only. Need a safe, low-overhead encoding though — maybe sample 1/1000 requests.

sandeep_runtime: agreed on sampling. For exploratory runs I'll run 100% on a small canary pool (2 GPUs). Quick query I used to correlate in our metrics backend: 
```
select percentile(ttft_tokens, 95) by route, time(1m)
| join (sum(selector_transition) by route, time(1m)) on route
| where selector_transition > 0
```

anna_ml: could add kernel_variant tag to token-level histogram (p50/p95 by kernel_variant) — that would let us see which kernel combo is causing the worst TTFT.

perfbot: [perf-bot] New metric instrumented: selector_transition counter (sampled) rolled to canary 6/2. Telemetry dashboard updated (draft panel).

mike_sre: nice. Action items: 1) lee add trace events (canary) 2) anna add kernel_variant histogram to token-breakdown panel 3) sandeep run repro and collect 2-3 traces and CSV of selector_transition vs ttft. I'll set an ad-hoc alert and watch during repro.

sandeep_runtime: starting repro now on canary pool. will post trace ids. thanks.

anna_ml: if we confirm it's selector jitter we should consider a debounce window in selector to avoid rapid flip-flops within a micro-slice. but fallback safety too.

lee_infra: noted. Debounce config could be a simple timestamp-based hold for X ms per request_id. we should model impact on latency for worst-case sequences first.

sandeep_runtime: repro traces: rt-20260318-29, rt-20260318-31, rt-20260318-33. Uploading logs to /var/tmp/rt-traces.zip and adding sample CSV to the ticket.

mike_sre: grabbing logs. I'll run the dashboard correlation and post graphs in a follow-up message. :thumbsup:

sandeep_runtime: thanks — leaving the canary repro running for an hour, ping me if you want live access.
